behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Assert nested native Error.cause output and a falsy primitive cause.
Assert identity-based cycle termination and unchanged error graph.
docDelivery: Explain exact cause-line format, primitive/undefined behavior and own-only traversal.
Describe identity cycle marker, unchanged graph and bounded input domain.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Same-realm Error chains <=200 distinct nodes, string names/messages, own data causes Error or primitive; inherited cause ignored.
independence: Expose cause chains in error presentation while preserving legacy messages and handling cycles safely.
